SELECT bill_no, mat_code, reservation_no, requirement_mat_code, MAX(requirement_mat_name) AS requirement_mat_name, MAX(substitute_flag) AS substitute_flag, MAX(substitute_ratio) AS substitute_ratio, MAX(mat_name) AS mat_name, MAX(mat_spec) AS mat_spec, MAX(mat_unit) AS mat_unit, mat_batch, MAX(supplier_code) AS supplier_code, MAX(supplier_name) AS supplier_name, warehouse_code, MAX(warehouse_name) AS warehouse_name, site_code, MAX(site_name) AS site_name, SUM(num) AS num, MAX(judge_status) AS judge_status, MAX(factory_code) AS factory_code FROM mes_warehouse_live_stock
mat_detail_type = 'RAW'
AND bill_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.billNo}, '%')
AND mat_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.matName}, '%')
AND mat_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.matCode}, '%')
AND mat_spec LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.matSpec}, '%')
AND mat_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.matName}, '%')
AND mat_batch LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.matBatch}, '%')
